title: Jing Daily: How Crocs Became One of TikTok Shop's Top Sellers
summary: Crocs chief brand officer Terence Reilly demonstrated the brand’s ‘audacious’ social strategy live at Brandweek.
body_markdown:
SUBSCRIPTION ONLY


Reilly was joined on stage at Brandweek by Wisdom Kaye and Liana Gibbs.


Ivan Piedra Photography


By[Rebecca Stewart](https://www.adweek.com/contributor/rebecca-stewart/)


Fashionistas might be divided on Crocs, but TikTok Shop isn’t.


The platform crowned Crocs its Seller of the Year in May, an accolade the brand earned through a test-and-learn approach to social designed to engage Gen Z and Gen Alpha, long before they hit the Buy button.


Crocs signed on as an early adopter of TikTok Shop in 2024 and racked up an estimated $52.4 million in sales in the 12 months to April, making it the top footwear seller on the platform,[according to data intelligence firm Charm.io](https://wwd.com/footwear-news/shoe-industry-news/crocs-hey-dude-qvc-tiktok-shoe-shop-sales-leaders-1238931788/) .


Speaking at ADWEEK’s Brandweek event in Atlanta, Crocs EVP and chief brand officer Terence Reilly gave a behind-the-scenes look at Crocs’ journey to the top.
